Hi Jennifer,

This form is mainly for issues related to poppr specifically. Please use the R-SIG-genetics forum for general questions: https://stat.ethz.ch/mailman/listinfo/r-sig-genetics

To answer your question, you might try looking at the pegas package for a HWE test.

Best,
Zhian
On Apr 17, 2016, at 11:53 , Jennifer Gruhn <jennife...@gmail.com> wrote:

Is it possible to do a 1-sided Exact Test for Hardy Weinberg Equilibrium in poppr/adegenet?  I didn't think so, but wanted to check!   

I am trying to remove excess heterozygosity, based on HWE.

I have also tried doing this in the HardyWeinberg package; however, the examples are not clear to me, when multiple loci have missing data.

Any help would be appreciated.
